ti.title: ድኅነት እትልምን
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ብሰላምታ ገብርኤል ብብስራት ገብርኤል
ሰላምታ ይብጻሕኪ ኪዳነ ምሕረት
[[/chorus]]

ድኅነት እትልምን ንደቅኻ ኵሉ (2)
ናዛዜ ሕዙናን ኣሜን (2)
ገብርኤል ለልዑል መልኣከ ኃይሉ

ንኣምን ብኣኻ ኣማላዲ ኢኻ
ንሰለስቱ ደቂቅ ካብ ሓዊ ዘውጻእካ

ti_ro.title: Dhnet 'tlmn
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Nazaze hzunan amen (2)
[[/chorus]]

Dhnet tlmn ndeqkha kwilu (2)
Gebrel lelul melake haylu
Bselamta gebrel bbsrat gebrel
Selamta ybtsahki kidane mhret
Namn bakha amaladi ikha
Nselestu deqiq kab hawi zewtsaka
Nselestu deqiq zewtsaka kab ton
Halhalta nay hawi zhul may gerkalom
